The regression harness caught this ONLY after fixing a harness bug that silently dropped lil (crate code in src/lil.rs not src/lib.rs). 0.20 = lowest weight giving cJSON full 0.55 with lil (and all 56 name-preserving libs) intact.
cjson.note: 22/40 with signal-C + input-scalar (baseline was 16/40). Source = crustbench cJSON.c (Dave Gamble, 58 C fns, == E1 name-preserving scorable). Baseline nailed the topology-rich recursive core (parse_*/print_*) but PERMUTED the flat leaf half (12x cJSON_Create*: ()->Value/(scalar)->Value, call nothing => zero topology). signal-C (type-tag/enum-variant jaccard, W=0.35, gated) recovered 7/12 constructors -> 0.50. input-scalar signal (input element-type jaccard, W=0.12, gated) splits the int/float/double/string-array trio that signal-C grouped under one 'array' tag -> 0.55. ABLATION: baseline 0.40, +signalC 0.50, +input-scalar-ALONE 0.40 (no effect without signalC), +BOTH 0.55 -- input-scalar only refines WITHIN signalC's tag groups (composition, not independent). Residual: CreateTrue/Bool (bool-literal asymmetry) + ~8 accessor family (Get/Add/Detach shallow shape + LLM helper attractors -- the real hard core, NOT pursued). name-eq 0.15 (LLM kept 6 parse_* verbatim). BOTH signals VALIDATED: ZERO regression across 55 name-preserving libs (results/rq1_matching/cells/regression/, two harness runs). See cjson/NOTES.md + regression/SIGNAL_C.md.

lil.note: THE boundary case: LLM DISOBEYED rename order, KEPT names (fnc_append verbatim, methodized to LilInterpreter::fnc_append). So leaf-name-eq=0.55 >= matcher 0.50 -> not the matchers regime (its edge is renamed code where name-eq->0). Matcher still nails FAMILY level 91% (all 55 fnc_ handlers pinned to handler family, zero leak). 29/32 misses = intra-family twin-swaps (fnc_inc/dec differ by +/- passed to shared helper; fnc_upeval/downeval by direction constant) -> discriminator invisible to shape/ops/topology/consts (op-histograms verified identical) = genuine structural ceiling, pushing higher=overfitting. Graceful degradation: c2rust exact-graph 0.97 -> LLM approx-graph 0.50, family held. Baseline ladder: random 0.9%, shape-only 9%, node 32%, full+neg+strings 55%. Two denominators: scorable 55/111=0.495, gross 55/128=0.43 (gap 6.6pp small). Partition asserted (truth+dissolved==128).
